title: The Secret Inside the Biryani Pot 🥘

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: WHO REPLACED MY MOM’S FAMOUS GOLDEN BIRYANI POT WITH THIS RUSTY TRASH OVERNIGHT! [beat] I’m not joking, my life is literally over if she sees this!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I saw a certain someone sneaking [beat] into the kitchen at midnight, and they weren’t looking for a snack, they were looking for a quick profit!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Don't you dare look at me, Nix! [beat] I might be a bully, but I’m not a common thief who steals heavy kitchenware from old ladies in the dark!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: That pot has been in our family for three generations, and it's the only reason [beat] the biryani tastes like heaven and not like dry cardboard!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Wait! I caught the whole thing on my [beat] bedroom security cam because I thought someone was trying to hack my gaming setup and steal my skins!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Riku, stop talking about your frame rates for one second [beat] and show us the footage before Phupu starts calling the actual police on all of us!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Is that... Uncle Jamal? Why are you [beat] wearing a ski mask and dragging a heavy sack toward the backyard garden shed like a cartoon villain?

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: It’s not what it looks like! [beat] I was just trying to protect the family legacy from a very specific type of expensive, metal-eating termite!

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: Uncle Jamal is totally lying! [beat] I saw him hiding a shiny gold key inside his expensive leather briefcase right before he started sweating!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Looks like the rich uncle isn't as rich as he [beat] pretends to be if he's hocking his sister’s kitchen supplies for some quick fast cash!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Open the briefcase right now, Jamal, or [beat] I’m calling the principal to report a family emergency that involves literal grand larceny!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: You don’t understand! The pot isn't just gold-plated... [beat] it contains the map to the real secret ingredient that started this whole mess!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Biryani Incident just became a treasure hunt. [beat] But the person holding the real map is the last person you would ever expect.
